warframes.description: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。 Ash 擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。
warframes.descriptionEn: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.

abilities.description: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.

abilities.description: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.

abilities.description: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。
abilities.descriptionEn: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.

scalars.label: Energy Discount On Blade Storm Target
scalars.labelEn: Energy Discount On Blade Storm Target
scalars.labelZh: 剑刃风暴目标能量折扣

abilities.description: 将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。
abilities.descriptionEn: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.

energyCost.noteZh: 隐身时每个标记的消耗减半

warframes.description: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。Atlas 可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。
warframes.descriptionEn: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.

abilities.description: 用爆炸性的滑行冲拳猛击敌人，最多重复三次，形成连击。三拳连击中的每一后续攻击都会增加攻击范围。土石坍方的每次命中都会减少能量消耗。可通过在土石坍方上装备 Mod 增加属性数值。
abilities.descriptionEn: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.

abilities.description: 召唤一堵「大地堡垒」石墙，再次启用技能可使巨石滚动压倒前方的敌人。被敌人攻击的石墙会释放一个区域性的切割伤害，由其失去的生命值来维持。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.

scalars.label: Health Multiplier To Slash Damage
scalars.labelZh: 生命值倍率至切割伤害

scalars.label: Invulnerability Duration
scalars.labelZh: 大地构筑 · 技能持续时间

abilities.description: Atlas 强硬的凝视将石化敌人并增加他们受到的伤害、治疗石头人，并创造出石化壁垒。当石化的敌人碎裂后，将掉出可以治疗 Atlas 的碎石。
abilities.descriptionEn: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 石化凝视 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 召唤两个元素石头近战打手。召唤动作将石化临近 Atlas 的敌人。当它们的生命结束时，石头人将碎成一堆用于治疗的碎石。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.

scalars.label: Rubble Dropped On Death Per Rumbler
scalars.labelEn: Rubble Dropped On Death Per Rumbler

warframes.passive: 在地面时无法被击倒。
warframes.passiveEn: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

warframes.description: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。
warframes.descriptionEn: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.

warframes.description: Banshee 的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。
warframes.descriptionEn: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.

abilities.description: Banshee 释放出足以瘫痪或击杀敌人的强力音速震波，击倒范围内的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.

abilities.description: Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。
abilities.descriptionEn: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.

abilities.description: Banshee 将自身垄罩在消声力场中，力场能眩晕敌人并限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的知觉与战术反应。
abilities.descriptionEn: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.

abilities.description: Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动地面。
abilities.descriptionEn: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.

warframes.passive: 消去武器的噪音，让敌人无法听见开火的声音。
warframes.passiveEn: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.

warframes.description: Banshee Prime 以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.passiveEn: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.

warframes.description: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。
warframes.descriptionEn: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.

abilities.description: 只处于没攻击时可闪避所有飞来的子弹。再使用一次可关闭该技能。
abilities.descriptionEn: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

abilities.description: 平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。
abilities.descriptionEn: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.

abilities.description: 召唤一群环绕的匕首并寻找敌人的枪支，用小型爆炸来摧毁它们。与「巧躲」结合来使范围加倍。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.

abilities.description: 随着他的「克制」被侵蚀，Baruuk 用「宁静风暴」来使拳脚作出强大的范围攻击。掌握风暴的每一刻会使他恢复「克制」。
abilities.descriptionEn: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

warframes.passive: 每当巧躲子弹，以及每当敌人被镇静或被离手戏法缴械时，Baruuk 的克制力就会逐渐被侵蚀，同时他内心的风暴也会愈演愈烈。随着克制力的下降，Baruuk 会逐渐提升对伤害的抵抗力，且至多能抵抗 |PERCENT|% 的伤害。
warframes.passiveEn: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

warframes.description: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。
warframes.descriptionEn: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.

warframes.description: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与 Sentient 形态在 Caliban 身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。
warframes.descriptionEn: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.

abilities.description: 在旋转的死亡漩涡中向前冲刺。被击中的敌人会受到 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态的影响，使其更易受到其他所有异常状态的伤害。每击中一个敌人，可恢复一部分能量消耗，以及生命值和护盾。被 Sentient 之怒举起的敌人受到额外伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.

abilities.description: 猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地抛向空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.

abilities.description: 在 Sentient 单位类型之间切换，然后将其召唤到 Caliban 的身旁。震荡使专注于原始近战伤害。直垂使擅长远程攻击并且能造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。召唤使能召唤自己的唱鸣使，并为小队提供护盾保护。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.

abilities.description: 将三股原始能量流汇聚至一个点上，引发巨大爆炸。这些能量流能剥离敌人的护甲和护盾，每个被击中的敌人都会在能量流汇聚时被引爆。召唤的震荡使可施放自己的迷你版融合打击。
abilities.descriptionEn: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.

warframes.passive: 经验分享范围内的队友受到伤害后获得最高 |PCT|% 对该种伤害类型的抗性。
warframes.passiveEn: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

warframes.description: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。
warframes.descriptionEn: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.

warframes.description: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：Cyte-09。
warframes.descriptionEn: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.

abilities.description: 放置一根天线向前发射扫描波。被探测到的敌人会受到更高的弱点伤害，并可透过墙壁被看到。武器获得穿透。

abilities.description:
投掷两个元素弹药包，可立即为当前的武器填满弹匣，同时为武器附加所选的元素伤害和异常状态。重新装填会清除效果。狙击枪可获得额外伤害。

长按技能键以选择元素伤害类型。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.

abilities.description: 向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗 Cyte-09。
abilities.descriptionEn: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.

abilities.description: 召唤肃清者，Cyte-09 的显赫狙击步枪。命中弱点的子弹会弹射追踪附近的其它弱点。次要射击发射 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻榴弹，完全冻结敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.

warframes.passive: 弱点击杀将使 Cyte-09 的弱点暴击几率增加 |INCREASE|%，最高可达 |CAP|%，持续至当前任务结束。
warframes.passiveEn: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by |INCREASE|% up to |CAP|% for the duration of the current mission.

warframes.description: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。Dagath 的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。
warframes.descriptionEn: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.

abilities.description: 命定镰刃包围 Dagath 并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。
abilities.descriptionEn: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.

abilities.description: 用厄运诅咒附近的敌人。Dagath 对敌人造成的部分伤害会通过命定镰刃再次施加。敌人还会受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.

abilities.description:
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。击杀和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 悲剧：连续施放两个「暗之诗句」能够攻击敌人。来自 切割、火焰和 毒素异常状态造成的持续伤害将累积成一次性的爆发。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 守词者：「明之诗句」后跟着「暗之诗句」，将以夜枭分身为友军提供支援。夜枭分身会与其指定友军同步进行攻击。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally’s attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

warframes.descriptionEn: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.

abilities.description: 穿过墨色框架，在目标地点以无敌的飞溅的墨汁出现，对附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

将 Follie 绘影集中的绘影图变为具有战术优势的道具。绘影图生成时会向附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

长按可打开绘影图轮盘。

Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.

abilities.descriptionEn: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.

abilities.description: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。
abilities.descriptionEn: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.

scalars.label: Invulnerability Duration
scalars.labelZh: 冰雪护罩 · 技能持续时间

abilities.description: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.

warframes.passive: Frost 技能造成的冰冻异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。Frost 从每个在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内受到 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态影响的敌人身上获得 |ARMOR| 护甲。
warframes.passiveEn: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.

warframes.description: Gara 以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。Gara 的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。
warframes.descriptionEn: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.

abilities.description: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.

abilities.description: Gara 的护甲会分裂为碎玻璃组成的漩涡。置身其中的友军可减免敌人的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 玻片风暴 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 光谱盛怒 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 创造一圈逐渐扩张的熔融玻璃环，进入环内的敌人将逐渐结晶化。当扩张完毕时，玻璃环将硬化并能阻挡外界火力。环可以从结晶化敌人的护盾和生命中获取额外的力量。使用「琉璃碎击」可以击碎玻璃环，并将尖锐的玻璃碎片击飞。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.

warframes.passive: 当 Gara 施放技能时，有几率使周围的敌人陷入目盲状态 |DURATION| 秒。
warframes.passiveEn: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.

warframes.description: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士 Gara 的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。
warframes.descriptionEn: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.

abilities.description: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.

warframes.description: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。Garuda 以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。
warframes.descriptionEn: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.

abilities.description: 从敌人身上割取生命之力以作为抵挡伤害的盾。蓄力可使抵挡的伤害化为爆裂破片。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.

scalars.label: Health To Heart Damage On Instant Kill
scalars.labelEn: Health To Heart Damage On Instant Kill

abilities.description: 以利爪构筑的祭坛刺穿敌人，为自己及队友吸取生命。
abilities.descriptionEn: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 鲜血祭坛 · 持续时间

abilities.description: Garuda 以她的生命值为代价换取能量并清除异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.

abilities.description: 蓄力可扩大瞄准区域，接着对瞄准区域里的每一名敌人发射高速利爪；幸存的敌人极有可能受 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态影响。
abilities.descriptionEn: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 穿心利爪 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 每一个 Garuda 所击杀的敌人都会为她暂时增加伤害，最高达到 |DAMAGE|%。如果她没有装备近战武器，则会使用其利爪进行斩击。
warframes.passiveEn:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.

warframes.description: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。
warframes.descriptionEn: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.

warframes.passiveEn:

warframes.description: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。Gauss 速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。
warframes.descriptionEn: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.

abilities.description: 猛冲产生一个超级冲刺来撞倒敌人并对电池蓄电，或是撞上坚固的物体来产生强大的震荡波。长按按键以持续冲刺。
abilities.descriptionEn: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.

scalars.label: Slash Status Chance From Kinetic Plating
scalars.labelEn: Slash Status Chance From Kinetic Plating
scalars.labelZh: 切割异常触发几率来自

abilities.description: 产生可以将一部份所吸收的动能伤害（物理、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻，以及　<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸）转成能量的动能镀层。同时也保护 Gauss 免于失去平衡或是被击倒。伤害抗性与电池电量是相对的。
abilities.descriptionEn: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.

scalars.labelZh: 动能镀层 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。
abilities.descriptionEn: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.

scalars.labelEn: Enemy Armor Reduction From Redline On Cold Combination: ≤
scalars.labelZh: 敌人护甲削减来自红线时冰冻:≤

abilities.description: 将 Gauss 的电池过载至超出安全上限，大幅增强他的技能并将射速、攻击速度、装填速度，以及施放速度都设置为超载状态。当超出安全上限时，电弧束会周期性地在 Gauss 身上跃动，并在技能停用时爆炸。
abilities.descriptionEn: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.

warframes.passiveEn: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.

warframes.descriptionEn: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.

warframes.description: Grendel 将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。
warframes.descriptionEn: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.

abilities.description: 将敌人囫囵吞入 Grendel 的腹内。按住技能键即可将腹内的敌人吐出，而这些敌人身上会覆盖着毒性消化液。
abilities.descriptionEn: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.

scalars.label: Maw Open Extra Duration Per Enemy
scalars.labelEn: Maw Open Extra Duration Per Enemy
scalars.labelZh: 巨口额外持续时间每敌人

abilities.description: Grendel 从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击 Grendel 或被 Grendel 攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。
abilities.descriptionEn: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.

abilities.description: Grendel 蜷缩成一个球，在此期间他会随时间流逝恢复生命值，并冲撞任何胆敢挡住他的人。跳跃会让 Grendel 朝地面猛砸，并产生一股破坏性的冲击波。
abilities.descriptionEn: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.

scalars.label: Collision Radius
scalars.labelZh: 肉弹碾压 · 半径（第2项）

abilities.description: 将浸泡在 Grendel 体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。
abilities.descriptionEn: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.

scalars.label: Bonus Damage From Launched Enemy'S Health
scalars.labelEn: Bonus Damage From Launched Enemy'S Health

warframes.passive: 每名被吞噬的敌人可提供 |ARMOUR| 额外护甲。
warframes.passiveEn: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.

warframes.description: 原始。永不饱足。Grendel Prime 吞食所有反抗他的人。
warframes.descriptionEn: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.

abilities.description: 将敌人囫囵吞入 Grendel 的腹内。按住技能键即可将腹内的敌人吐出，而这些敌人身上会覆盖着毒性消化液。
abilities.descriptionEn: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.

scalars.label: Maw Open Extra Duration Per Enemy
scalars.labelEn: Maw Open Extra Duration Per Enemy
scalars.labelZh: 巨口额外持续时间每敌人

abilities.description: Grendel 从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击 Grendel 或被 Grendel 攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。
abilities.descriptionEn: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.

abilities.description: Grendel 蜷缩成一个球，在此期间他会随时间流逝恢复生命值，并冲撞任何胆敢挡住他的人。跳跃会让 Grendel 朝地面猛砸，并产生一股破坏性的冲击波。
abilities.descriptionEn: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.

scalars.label: Collision Radius
scalars.labelZh: 肉弹碾压 · 半径（第2项）

abilities.description: 将浸泡在 Grendel 体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。
abilities.descriptionEn: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.

scalars.label: Bonus Damage From Launched Enemy'S Health
scalars.labelEn: Bonus Damage From Launched Enemy'S Health

warframes.passive: 每名被吞噬的敌人可提供 |ARMOUR| 额外护甲。
warframes.passiveEn: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.

warframes.description: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，Gyre 的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。
warframes.descriptionEn: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.

abilities.description: 发射一颗回旋球体，在撞击时造成大量伤害，并且可以定期对周围的敌人产生电击。在初始发射时一次性击中多名敌人来提升伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.

scalars.label: Initial Enemies Hit For Enhanced Damage
scalars.labelEn: Initial Enemies Hit For Enhanced Damage

abilities.description: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。
abilities.descriptionEn: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.

scalars.label: Sphere Lifetime
scalars.labelZh: 旋爆视界 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Implosion Lifetime
scalars.labelZh: 旋爆视界 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 在短时内可获取提升的暴击几率和能量恢复，每击杀一名敌人都可以延长「阴极泰来」的持续时间。施放后进入技能冷却时间。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.

scalars.label: Casting Cooldown And Max Duration Cap
scalars.labelEn: Casting Cooldown And Max Duration Cap
scalars.labelZh: 冷却时间与最大持续时间上限

abilities.description: Gyre 的机械装置会以令人难以置信的速度高速旋转产生一个电场，并电击附近的敌人。当 Gyre 造成暴击后，被击中的敌人处会产生一个巨大的电流来攻击附近的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 超旋链波 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 每个对敌人产生影响的电击异常状态使 Gyre 的技能有 10% 几率对该敌人造成暴击伤害。
warframes.passiveEn: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.

warframes.description: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与 Gyre Prime 一起舞向永恒。
warframes.descriptionEn: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.

abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.

warframes.description: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。
warframes.descriptionEn: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.

abilities.description: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化 Harrow 的护盾。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 责难束缚 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 牺牲一定护盾来提升装填和射速，同时将施加于敌人的伤害转化为 Harrow 和附近友军的生命。
abilities.descriptionEn: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.

abilities.description: 将 Harrow 的能量导引至「聚能焚炉」以产生增幅效果。一旦导引完成，击杀敌人就会给予附近友军能量喷发。导引使用的能量越多，每个击杀获得的返还奖励就越高。爆头可产生额外能量。
abilities.descriptionEn: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Headshots produce extra energy.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 聚能焚炉 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 以能量保护附近的友军，对处于「庇佑圣约」保护下的所有人，可吸收一切伤害并将之转化为暴击几率的加成。爆头时暴击几率将被进一步增幅。
abilities.descriptionEn: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Headshots are amplified even further.

scalars.label: Headshot Multiplier To Bonus Critical Chance
scalars.labelEn: Headshot Multiplier To Bonus Critical Chance
scalars.labelZh: 爆头倍率至加成暴击几率

warframes.passive:
拥有双倍过载护盾容量。
任务开始时获得最大能量。
warframes.passiveEn:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.

warframes.description: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。
warframes.descriptionEn: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.

warframes.description: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。
warframes.descriptionEn: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.

abilities.description: 蓄力并迸发毁灭性的闪电。
abilities.descriptionEn: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.

scalars.label: Ragdoll Chance On Hit With Overshield
scalars.labelEn: Ragdoll Chance On Hit With Overshield
scalars.labelZh: 几率时命中带有过载护盾

abilities.description: 掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除 Hildryn 和她队友的异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.

abilities.description: 在友军周围创造一道护盾光环。敌人会在靠近 Hildryn 时受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.

scalars.label: Extra Damage Per Second With Overshield
scalars.labelEn: Extra Damage Per Second With Overshield
scalars.labelZh: 额外每秒伤害带有过载护盾

scalars.label: econds of shield gating for allies
scalars.labelEn: econds of shield gating for allies

abilities.description: 升上天空并对敌人降下野火火箭。附近的敌人会被炸向空中，且每隔数秒就会在他们身上生成一颗能量球。当护盾耗尽后敌人将被摔回地面。
abilities.descriptionEn: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.

warframes.passive: Hildryn 的满护盾保险时间很长。在她的护盾耗尽后，她在 3.5 秒内免疫伤害。
warframes.passiveEn: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.

warframes.description: Hildryn Prime 证明了权力是纪律的回报。
warframes.descriptionEn: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.

warframes.description: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。
warframes.descriptionEn: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.

abilities.description: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 暴风雨弹幕 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.

abilities.description: 从附近敌人身上掠夺护甲，并为你的技能和武器附加 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态影响的敌人将提供更多加成。
abilities.descriptionEn: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.

scalars.label: Corrosive Bonus Damage Per Enemy Per Corrosive Status
scalars.labelEn: Corrosive Bonus Damage Per Enemy Per Corrosive Status
scalars.labelZh: 腐蚀加成伤害每敌人每腐蚀异常

abilities.description: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 触角肆虐 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 被 Hydroid 伤害的敌人更容易受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态的影响，首次触发降低护甲 |PCT|%。
warframes.passiveEn: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.

warframes.description: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。
warframes.descriptionEn: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.

abilities.description: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。
abilities.descriptionEn: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 枯沙竭血 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 化身为沙尘暴。Inaros 吞噬被卷入沙暴中的敌人，并治愈自己。
abilities.descriptionEn: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 吞天沙暴 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 将 Inaros 的生命值来转化为护甲。再次使用可以提前终止护甲的转化。保护层减少受到的伤害并使 Inaros 免疫异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.

scalars.label: Health Drain Per Percent Charge
scalars.labelZh: 生命值耗能每百分比充能

abilities.description: 召唤带有 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀触发效果的圣甲虫群来攻击敌人。伤害与 Inaros 的生命值成正比。被虫群淹没的敌人死亡后会召唤一个沙土库娃，与 Inaros 并肩作战，并引导圣甲虫找到其他敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.

scalars.label: Swarm Duration
scalars.labelZh: 圣甲虫群 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Health As Corrosive Damage Per Half Sec
scalars.labelEn: Health As Corrosive Damage Per Half Sec
scalars.labelZh: 生命值作为腐蚀伤害每秒

scalars.label: Swarm Kavat Lifespan
scalars.labelZh: 圣甲虫群 · 持续时间（第2项）

warframes.passive: 当 Inaros 受到致命伤害时，他会将自己封入石棺中，并化身为沙土攻击敌人，吸取他们的生命力来复活自己。
warframes.passiveEn: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.

warframes.description: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把 Inaros 带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

abilities.description: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。
abilities.descriptionEn: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 枯沙竭血 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 化身为沙尘暴。Inaros 吞噬被卷入沙暴中的敌人，并治愈自己。
abilities.descriptionEn: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 吞天沙暴 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 将 Inaros 的生命值来转化为护甲。再次使用可以提前终止护甲的转化。保护层减少受到的伤害并使 Inaros 免疫异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.

scalars.label: Health Drain Per Percent Charge
scalars.labelZh: 生命值耗能每百分比充能

abilities.description: 召唤带有 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀触发效果的圣甲虫群来攻击敌人。伤害与 Inaros 的生命值成正比。被虫群淹没的敌人死亡后会召唤一个沙土库娃，与 Inaros 并肩作战，并引导圣甲虫找到其他敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.

warframes.passiveEn: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.

warframes.description: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。 Ivara 善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。
warframes.descriptionEn: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.

abilities.description: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使 Ivara 和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.

abilities.description: 操控 Ivara 所发射出的投射物并引导飞向目标处。
abilities.descriptionEn: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.

abilities.description: 进入隐身状态并从毫无警觉的敌人身上偷取道具，或以致命的爆头射击取走猎物的性命。
abilities.descriptionEn: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.

abilities.description: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

warframes.descriptionEn: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.

warframes.description: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。
warframes.descriptionEn: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.

abilities.description: 创造一口圣光之井治愈友军并对敌人造成伤害。进入井中的敌人将被“审判”标记。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.

abilities.descriptionEn: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.

scalars.label: Power of The Seven Ability Strength bonus

abilities.description: Jade 召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护盾和护甲。当谴责之瞳凝视友军时，可以将其远距离复活。
abilities.descriptionEn: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.

scalars.label: Damage armor and shield strip per second
scalars.labelEn: Damage armor and shield strip per second

abilities.description: 以毁灭性的力量翱翔天际。使用次要射击引爆审判，造成翠玉之光爆炸。处于圣光审判影响范围内的敌人会增强爆炸效果。
abilities.descriptionEn: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.

scalars.label: Damage Alternate Fire Heat damage
scalars.labelZh: 伤害替代火焰火焰伤害

scalars.labelEn: Judgment chance on Glory primary fire

warframes.passive: Jade 对生与死的深刻理解赋予她两个光环 Mod 槽位。某些技能会施加“审判”，使敌人获得 |CHANCE|% 易伤，持续 |DURATION| 秒。
warframes.passiveEn: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by |CHANCE|% for |DURATION|s.

warframes.description: Khora 有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。
warframes.descriptionEn: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.

abilities.description: 在欲聋的鞭打声中将敌人击退。装备在「长鞭利爪」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.

scalars.label: Strangledome Damage Distribution
scalars.labelZh: 长鞭利爪 · 伤害（第2项）

abilities.description: 使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 束缚陷阱 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Reduced Duration
scalars.labelZh: 束缚陷阱 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 命令薇娜丽专注于一名目标；按住技能来切换攻击，保护和治疗形态；若薇娜丽阵亡，使用此技能可以立即复活她。
abilities.descriptionEn: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.

abilities.descriptionEn: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.

scalars.label: Grab Radius

warframes.passiveEn: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.

warframes.descriptionEn: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.

warframes.description: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。
warframes.descriptionEn: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.

abilities.description:
编织命运之线。触碰命运之线的敌人会受到随机元素异常状态的影响。

投掷出三个六点会产生可以造成所有元素异常状态的线。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.

scalars.label: Star Bounce And Thread Contact Damage dice roll
scalars.labelEn: Star Bounce And Thread Contact Damage dice roll

scalars.label: Star Bounce Damage With Triple Sixes: ~ dice roll
scalars.labelEn: Star Bounce Damage With Triple Sixes: ~ dice roll

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 命运编织 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Stacks Of Random Elemental Status Effect On Star Bounce
scalars.labelEn: Stacks Of Random Elemental Status Effect On Star Bounce
scalars.labelZh: 层数的随机异常效果时

scalars.label: Stack Of All Elemental Statuses On Star Bounce And Thread Contact With Triple Sixes
scalars.labelEn: Stack Of All Elemental Statuses On Star Bounce And Thread Contact With Triple Sixes

abilities.description:
Koumei 预视到了一个美好的未来以及实现它的具体步骤。完成挑战即可获得王令。运气不好的掷骰结果会带来一种减益，但你可以长按技能键以放弃该御神签。

掷出三个六则可以直接获得王令，无需挑战。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.

scalars.label: ≤ unlucky dice roll with random penalty
scalars.labelEn: ≤ unlucky dice roll with random penalty

abilities.description:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间获得无敌效果。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

abilities.description:
像操纵牵线木偶一样操纵敌人的命运之线。Koumei 的骰子决定了 Koumei 面前的敌人将承受的异常状态数量。

掷出三个六会造成持续的额外异常状态，并将人偶戏效果延伸到 Koumei 背后的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

warframes.passive: 每隔 |DURATION| 秒，Koumei 的一件武器将会造成随机异常状态，持续 |DURATION| 秒。
warframes.passiveEn: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.

warframes.description: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。
warframes.descriptionEn: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.

abilities.description:
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.

scalars.label: Damage melee final critical chance
scalars.labelZh: 伤害近战最终暴击几率

scalars.label: Duration melee crit buff duration
scalars.labelZh: 持续时间近战暴击增益持续时间

abilities.description: Kullervo 用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击 Kullervo，对他造成少量伤害。Kullervo 拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。
abilities.descriptionEn: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.

scalars.label: Damage lash damage per dagger hit
scalars.labelEn: Damage lash damage per dagger hit
scalars.labelZh: 每把匕首命中鞭击伤害

scalars.label: Damage or Overguard per dagger hit
scalars.labelEn: Damage or Overguard per dagger hit
scalars.labelZh: 伤害或超宏防护每匕首命中

abilities.description: 虚空以匕首雨的形式回应 Kullervo 的呼唤，向他的敌人倾泄。
abilities.descriptionEn: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 乌戈风暴 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 当 Kullervo 使用任意近战武器攻击时，其重击效率 +|EFFICIENCY|%，并且重击准备速度 +|WINDUP|%。
warframes.passiveEn: Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.

warframes.description: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。
warframes.descriptionEn: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.

abilities.description:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗 Lavos。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

abilities.description:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.

scalars.label: Cold Status Effect Stacks Per Proc
scalars.labelEn: Cold Status Effect Stacks Per Proc
scalars.labelZh: 冰冻异常效果层数每触发

abilities.description:
布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.

scalars.label: Large Universal Orb Restore /EP
scalars.labelZh: 通用球体恢复/能量（第2项）

abilities.description:
从 Lavos 体内迸发出催化探头，并把炽热的凝胶泼向对手。敌人身上每有一种元素异常状态，该技能的伤害便翻倍一次。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

warframes.passive:
能量球和通用补给球可使 Lavos 对异常状态免疫 |DURATION| 秒。

长按任意技能键，来在下一次施放时注入额外的元素伤害和异常状态。
warframes.passiveEn:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.

warframes.description: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是 Prime 的。Lavos 是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。
warframes.descriptionEn: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.

warframes.description: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。 Limbo 通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.

abilities.description: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。
abilities.descriptionEn: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.

scalars.label: Rift Energy Regen Per Second e/s
scalars.labelEn: Rift Energy Regen Per Second e/s

abilities.description: 使被裂隙束缚的敌人静止。当其激活时，敌人的子弹将会被截停在半空中，停滞结束后这些子弹将会按照原先的弹道继续行进。
abilities.descriptionEn: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.

abilities.description: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被击杀时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。
abilities.descriptionEn: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.

scalars.label: Surge Duration
scalars.labelZh: 裂隙涌流 · 持续时间

scalars.labelZh: 裂隙涌流 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。
abilities.descriptionEn: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.

scalars.label: Rift Energy Regen Per Second e/s
scalars.labelEn: Rift Energy Regen Per Second e/s

warframes.passive: 闪避动作可以进入或退出裂隙位面。进入位面时会留下一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的小型裂隙传送门。身处裂隙位面之中时，能量会缓慢恢复，并且每一个在裂隙位面被杀死的敌人都会产生 |ENERGY| 点能量恢复。
warframes.passiveEn: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.

warframes.description: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: Loki 精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。
warframes.descriptionEn: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.

abilities.description: Loki 会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力。分身会根据附近敌人的数量获得生命值和护盾。
abilities.descriptionEn: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.

abilities.description: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。
abilities.descriptionEn: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.

abilities.description: Loki瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.

abilities.description: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。
abilities.descriptionEn: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.

warframes.passive: 壁面攀附时间提升 |MULT| 倍。
warframes.passiveEn: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.

warframes.description: 混淆、误导与破坏是 Loki Prime 的代名词。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。Mag 通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。
warframes.descriptionEn: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.

abilities.description: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。
abilities.descriptionEn: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.

abilities.description:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕 Mag 运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）Mag 将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.

scalars.labelZh: 磁吸力场 · 持续时间

abilities.descriptionEn: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.

warframes.description: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。Mesa 是该领域最快的拔枪手。
warframes.descriptionEn: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.

abilities.description: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。
abilities.descriptionEn: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.

abilities.description: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.

abilities.description: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.

scalars.label: Duration

scalars.label: hitscan reflect range

abilities.description: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。
abilities.descriptionEn: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.

warframes.passive: 双持次要武器的射速提升 |SPEED|%，单持次要武器的装填速度提升 |RELOAD|%。未装备近战武器时，获得 |HEALTH| 额外生命值。
warframes.passiveEn: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.

warframes.description: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

abilities.description: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。
abilities.descriptionEn: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.

abilities.description: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.

abilities.description: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.

scalars.label: Duration

abilities.description: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。
abilities.descriptionEn: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.

warframes.passive: 双持次要武器的射速提升 |SPEED|%，单持次要武器的装填速度提升 |RELOAD|%。未装备近战武器时，获得 |HEALTH| 额外生命值。
warframes.passiveEn: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.

warframes.description: Mirage 的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。
warframes.descriptionEn: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.

abilities.description: Mirage 创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.

abilities.descriptionEn: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.

abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.

abilities.descriptionEn: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.

warframes.passive: 滑行持续时间延长 |DURATION|% 且机动动作的速度加快 |SPEED|%。
warframes.passiveEn: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.

warframes.description: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。
warframes.descriptionEn: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.

abilities.description: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。
abilities.descriptionEn: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.

abilities.description: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.

abilities.description: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。
abilities.descriptionEn: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.

abilities.description: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.

warframes.passive: 每当周围 |RADIUS| 米范围内有敌人死亡时，恢复 |HEALTH| 生命。
warframes.passiveEn: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.

warframes.description: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。
warframes.descriptionEn: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.

abilities.description: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。
abilities.descriptionEn: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.

scalars.label: Flame Duration
scalars.labelZh: 风火飞轮 · 持续时间

scalars.label: trail duration
scalars.labelZh: 风火飞轮 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 掷出一个可点燃敌人的火圈，使敌人更易受到伤害。燃烧的敌人可掉落恢复球。蓄力可增强火圈的力量，再次激活技能可瞬间传送至火圈的位置。
abilities.descriptionEn: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 乾坤火圈 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 制造出守护火环，对靠近的敌人造成伤害并晕眩。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.

abilities.description: 用破地而出的长矛将附近的敌人刺起。再次使用技能可以将幸存的敌人猛拍回地面。
abilities.descriptionEn: Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 圣火尖枪 · 持续时间

warframes.description: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。
warframes.descriptionEn: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.

abilities.description: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.

scalars.label: Initial Hit Damage Puncture Damage
scalars.labelZh: 初始命中伤害穿刺伤害

abilities.description: 生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被杀死的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。
abilities.descriptionEn: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.

abilities.description: 以寄生链接绑定目标。施展对象为友军时，Nidus 与宿主的技能强度和武器伤害都会提升；连结至敌方时，宿主可为 Nidus 承受部分伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 寄生链接 · 持续时间

scalars.label: post link brake effect grace period
scalars.labelEn: post link brake effect grace period

abilities.description: 异常贪婪的蛆虫群包围敌人并据以为食，直到敌人被「致病力」命中并在身上爆发感染为止。突变适性对蛆虫有增益效果，而每击中一名敌人会增加突变适性的累积。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.

warframes.passive: 如果 Nidus 在被击杀时拥有至少 |STACKS| 层突变适性，那么这 |STACKS| 层突变适性会被消耗掉；同时 Nidus 会获得 |DURATION| 秒无敌时间并恢复 |HEAL|% 的生命。
warframes.passiveEn: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.

warframes.description: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的瘟疫之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。
warframes.descriptionEn: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.

warframes.description: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里
warframes.descriptionEn: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you

abilities.description: 扔出一个周期性释放有毒孢子的蘑菇，对附近的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害和异常状态，同时使他们陷入睡眠状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.

scalars.label: Viral Status Chance and Sleep on pulse
scalars.labelEn: Viral Status Chance and Sleep on pulse
scalars.labelZh: 病毒异常触发几率与睡眠时脉冲

abilities.description: 释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。
abilities.descriptionEn: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.

scalars.label: Ability Strength bonus duration
scalars.labelZh: 技能强度加成持续时间

abilities.description: 恢复为菌宝形态，生成使 Nokko 快速愈合和加速的球体。在此状态下，Nokko 无法被选为攻击目标并且会逐渐恢复。
abilities.descriptionEn: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.

scalars.label: Damage Health/Shield Restore per pickup
scalars.labelZh: 伤害生命值/护盾恢复每拾取

scalars.label: Duration Duration
scalars.labelZh: 根系再生 · 持续时间

scalars.label: move speed bonus duration
scalars.labelZh: 移动速度增益持续时间

abilities.description: 释放一个混乱的弹道蘑菇，会追踪敌人并在触碰目标后爆炸反弹。接触 Nokko 的任何蘑菇都会使其活化，脉冲频率翻倍。
abilities.descriptionEn: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.

warframes.passive: 当 Nokko 受到致命伤害后会恢复为菌宝形态，其激活的蘑菇会发光，触碰后可使 Nokko 复活。生成的光球会有加速效果，但不会提供治疗效果。如果未能及时到达发光蘑菇，Nokko 将自动复活。
warframes.passiveEn: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.

warframes.description: 利用反物质。 Nova 使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。
warframes.descriptionEn: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.

abilities.description: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.

scalars.label: particle duration
scalars.labelZh: 湮灭流星群 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.

abilities.description: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。
abilities.descriptionEn: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.

abilities.description: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。
abilities.descriptionEn: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.

scalars.label: Prime Duration
scalars.labelZh: 分子填充 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 处于减速状态下的敌人被击杀后有 |CHANCE|% 几率掉落生命球。处于加速状态下的敌人被击杀有 |CHANCE|% 几率掉落能量球。
warframes.passiveEn: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.

warframes.description: Nova Prime 以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

abilities.description: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.

scalars.label: particle duration

warframes.passiveEn: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.

warframes.description: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。
warframes.descriptionEn: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.

abilities.description: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 精神控制 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Teleport Range
scalars.labelZh: 精神控制 · 范围（第2项）

abilities.description: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.

abilities.description: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 精神混乱 · 持续时间

abilities.description: Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.

scalars.label: Damage Converted To Weapon Damage Bonus
scalars.labelEn: Damage Converted To Weapon Damage Bonus

scalars.label: Weapon Damage Bonus Duration
scalars.labelZh: 武器伤害增益持续时间

warframes.passive: Nyx 的 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内每有一个困惑的敌人，就会为她的主要武器和次要武器增加 |CRITICAL|% 暴击几率。最高增加 |MAX|% 暴击几率。
warframes.passiveEn: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.

warframes.description: 通过 Nyx Prime 来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。
warframes.descriptionEn: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.

abilities.description: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.

scalars.label: Initial Target Armor And Overguard Removal
scalars.labelEn: Initial Target Armor And Overguard Removal
scalars.labelZh: 初始目标护甲与超宏防护

abilities.description: 圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。
abilities.descriptionEn: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 神圣领域 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。
abilities.descriptionEn: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.

abilities.description: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。
abilities.descriptionEn: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.

scalars.label: Bonus Armor Per Radiation Status Effect
scalars.labelEn: Bonus Armor Per Radiation Status Effect
scalars.labelZh: 加成护甲每辐射异常效果

warframes.passive: 当 Oberon 拾取 <HEALTH>生命球时，他与 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围的友军获得正义否决，使玩家抵挡下一次受到的伤害。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。
warframes.passiveEn: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.

warframes.description: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

warframes.description: Octavia 将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。
warframes.descriptionEn: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.

abilities.description: 随着节奏对附近的敌人造成伤害，并吸引他们的火力。施加在槌音铮鏦上的伤害会增加其杀伤力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 槌音铮鏦 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 发射一枚滚球，利用音乐的渲染力令敌人跟随它。与槌音铮鏦相结合便可创造出一个徘徊移动的音波破坏球。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.

scalars.label: Blast Total Damage Per Song Loop, Per Enemy In Range
scalars.labelEn: Blast Total Damage Per Song Loop, Per Enemy In Range
scalars.labelZh: 爆炸伤害每 , 每敌人在范围

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 共鸣渲染 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Enemies To Max Out Charm Radius
scalars.labelEn: Enemies To Max Out Charm Radius

abilities.description: 给予随着 Octavia 的音乐做出相应动作的人各类增益效果。合拍的跳跃提供轻挑快板速度加成。跟上节拍的下蹲给予夜曲的隐匿增益。有节奏地射击可获得歌剧戏曲的多重射击加成。合拍的近战攻击给以强音奏鸣曲伤害加成。
abilities.descriptionEn: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.

scalars.label: Ability Duration
scalars.labelZh: 谐韵节拍 · 技能持续时间

abilities.description: 从环境的分贝水平中获取能量，用来扩大 Octavia 和友军的伤害增幅。同时将附近槌音铮鏦的伤害和范围加倍。
abilities.descriptionEn: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 强音增幅 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 每当使用技能后，Octavia 及其周围 |RANGE| 米内的队友就会在 |DURATION| 秒内恢复 |ENERGY| 点能量。
warframes.passiveEn: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.

warframes.description: 女音乐家 Octavia，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
