warframes.description: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。
warframes.descriptionEn: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.

abilities.description: 跳到敌人身上，用 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿刺穿他们，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。用这个攻击击败敌人时，他们将有几率掉落生命球或能量球。
abilities.descriptionEn: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia’s spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.

scalars.label: Damage Health Orb Drop Chance
scalars.labelZh: 伤害生命值球体掉落几率

scalars.label: Damage Energy Orb Drop Chance
scalars.labelZh: 伤害能量球体掉落几率

abilities.description: Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 网缚之拥 · 持续时间

abilities.description: Oraxia 向她前方发射一连串带刺的飞镖，并施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。中毒的敌人被击杀后会生成急行蛛。
abilities.descriptionEn: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.

scalars.label: Duration Mark Duration
scalars.labelZh: 持续时间标记持续时间

abilities.description:
展开 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿，开始狩猎。Oraxia 免疫异常状态并提升最大生命值。她的远程武器充满 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。击杀敌人会使其爆发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素。

蛛丝游走：轻按冲刺即可跳跃至目标表面。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.

scalars.label: Damage Wall Latch Toxin Weapon Damage
scalars.labelEn: Damage Wall Latch Toxin Weapon Damage
scalars.labelZh: 伤害毒素武器伤害（第2项）

warframes.passive: 壁面攀附可获得「捕食者的潜伏」效果，使 Oraxia 在 |DURATION| 秒内隐身。
warframes.passiveEn: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.

warframes.description: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。
warframes.descriptionEn: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

abilities.description:
使用 Orion 的邪恶镰刀击退敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害和异常状态，同时削弱敌人的护盾和护甲。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用日冕抛射。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.

abilities.description:
将 Orion 包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用翠玉之星。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.

scalars.label: clone duration
scalars.labelZh: 星壳 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description:
Orion 形成一个漂移的黑洞，将敌人困于其引力之中。以「重力斩」或「日冕抛射」命中黑洞可延长其持续时间，并改变其移动轨迹：「重力斩」会使其远离 Orion，而「日冕抛射」会将其拉向 Sirius。

（按住）切换至 Sirius 并使用「光之圣域」。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 事件视界 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.

warframes.passive:
在两者之间切换可使接下来的 |COUNT| 次施放获得 |EFFICIENCY|% 技能效率。

当能量低于 50 时，Sirius & Orion 会互相窃取能量。
warframes.passiveEn:
Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.

warframes.description: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。
warframes.descriptionEn: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.

abilities.description:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 手雷散射 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 炽烈炮击 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 后勤支援 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，Protea 可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从 Protea 放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时死亡的话，启用回溯会使 Protea 回到过去，从而使其免于死亡。Protea 仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.

scalars.label: Anchor Duration
scalars.labelZh: 时泊之锚 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Self Knockdown Chance On Lethal Hit
scalars.labelEn: Self Knockdown Chance On Lethal Hit

warframes.passive: 每第 |CASTS| 次施放技能可获得 +|STRENGTH|% 的技能强度。
warframes.passiveEn: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.

warframes.description: 看这位双父之女。Protea Prime 曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承 Tenno 的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。
warframes.descriptionEn: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.

abilities.description:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。

warframes.description: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。
warframes.descriptionEn: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.

abilities.description: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.

scalars.label: Duration pillar duration
scalars.labelZh: 持续时间柱体持续时间

abilities.description: 遏制威胁。Qorvex 召唤出墙壁并使其猛烈撞击在一起，对夹在其中的所有敌人造成伤害并造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态。
abilities.descriptionEn: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.

abilities.description: 保护自己和附近的友军免受异常状态影响。Qorvex 每次击杀或协助击杀受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射状态影响的敌人时，辐量防护可以阻止的异常状态数量会增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.

scalars.label: Damage initial status immunity stacks
scalars.labelZh: 伤害初始异常免疫层数

scalars.label: Damage ax status immunity stacks
scalars.labelZh: 伤害最大异常免疫层数

scalars.label: + stack chance per active Radiation status on enemy from kills and assists
scalars.labelEn: + stack chance per active Radiation status on enemy from kills and assists
scalars.labelZh: + 层数几率每激活辐射异常时敌人来自与

abilities.description: 从 Qorvex 的堆芯中释放光束。对命中的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，且必定触发异常状态。命中受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人会引发链式反应爆炸。
abilities.descriptionEn: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.

scalars.label: Damage Radiation total damage per second
scalars.labelEn: Damage Radiation total damage per second

scalars.label: Damage Radiation base damage per explosion
scalars.labelEn: Damage Radiation base damage per explosion
scalars.labelZh: 伤害辐射基础伤害每爆炸

scalars.label: Damage Radiation extra damage per status
scalars.labelEn: Damage Radiation extra damage per status
scalars.labelZh: 伤害辐射额外伤害每异常

scalars.label: + explosions per irradiated enemy in chain reaction
scalars.labelEn: + explosions per irradiated enemy in chain reaction

warframes.passive: Qorvex 所持有武器具有额外的 |PUNCH_THROUGH| 穿透。
warframes.passiveEn: Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.

warframes.description: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的 Revenant，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。
warframes.descriptionEn: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.

abilities.description: 将目标转化为一个狂热的奴仆。奴仆会攻击他们的友军，并通过伤害奴役更多目标。当目标死亡后，将会分解为可以产生伤害的能量柱。成群的奴仆将持续受到 Revenant 控制，直到此技能结束。
abilities.descriptionEn: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.

scalars.label: Pillar Impact Puncture Slash Damage/S
scalars.labelZh: 柱体冲击穿刺切割伤害/秒

scalars.label: Projectile Stagger On Hit
scalars.labelZh: 投射物命中时击退/眩晕

abilities.description: 受到 Sentient 能量包围，偏转伤害并震晕胆敢攻击者。奴役被震晕的敌人不消耗能量。
abilities.descriptionEn: Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.

abilities.description: 化为一堵由 Sentient 能量组成的墙壁穿过敌人，吸取所接触敌人的护盾和生命，来自奴仆的效果受到增幅。
abilities.descriptionEn: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 精华掠夺 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 喷发出数条夜灵能量光束，形成一个死亡之环扫荡 Revenant 的四周。光束会根据所选的防御调整伤害类型，而 Revenant 遭受的伤害将转化为光束伤害。按住射击键可以额外能量为代价强化异常状态和伤害。被此技能杀死的奴仆将掉落过载护盾可拾取物。
abilities.descriptionEn: Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.

warframes.passive: 每当护盾被耗尽时，释放一道能造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害并将周围 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人击倒的冲击波。
warframes.passiveEn: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.

warframes.description: 迷失者之崛起。使用 Revenant Prime 的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。
warframes.descriptionEn: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.

warframes.description: Rhino 重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。
warframes.descriptionEn: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.

abilities.description: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.

abilities.description: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.

scalars.label: Invulnerability Duration
scalars.labelZh: 钢化皮肤 · 技能持续时间

abilities.description: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。
abilities.descriptionEn: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.

abilities.description: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 犀牛践踏 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 从高处落地时会产生一道能造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害的冲击波。
warframes.passiveEn: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.

warframes.description: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使 RHINO 地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。
warframes.descriptionEn: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.

abilities.description: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。
abilities.descriptionEn: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.

abilities.descriptionEn: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.

warframes.passiveEn: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.

warframes.description: 剧毒是 Saryn 的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对 Saryn 来说，毒液是一种美德。
warframes.descriptionEn: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.

warframes.descriptionEn: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.

abilities.description: Sevagoth 的幽影向外飞去来蹂躏路径上的敌人。幸存者会随时间流逝，受到来自「死亡收割」的伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

warframes.descriptionEn: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.

warframes.description: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。
warframes.descriptionEn: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

abilities.description:
投掷 Sirius 的翠玉之光镰刀，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并拾取路径上的所有物品。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用重力斩。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.

abilities.description:
Sirius 召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用星壳。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 翠玉之星 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius 会创造一个光之井，治疗并复活友军，同时减少受到的伤害。光之井的体积和威力会缓慢增长。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用事件视界。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 光之圣域 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.

warframes.passive:
在两者之间切换可使接下来的 |COUNT| 次施放获得 |EFFICIENCY|% 技能效率。

当能量低于 50 时，Sirius & Orion 会互相窃取能量。
warframes.passiveEn:
Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.

warframes.description: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。
warframes.descriptionEn: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.

abilities.description: 投掷一支崇敬标枪。当标枪将敌人钉在墙上时，周围的敌人会被拉近并遭受爆发式伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.

scalars.label: Vortex Lifetime
scalars.labelZh: 崇敬标枪 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 召唤豪勇，Styanax 之盾。挥舞豪勇击退敌人并减少他们的护盾和护甲。每击中一名敌人，Styanax 都会恢复生命值。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.

scalars.label: Health Restore Per Enemy Hit
scalars.labelZh: 生命值恢复每敌人命中

abilities.description: 将敌人的注意力引向 Styanax。他的决心会鼓舞附近的友军和自己，使其随时间恢复能量。Styanax 和他的队友每次杀敌助攻都会恢复护盾。
abilities.descriptionEn: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.

abilities.description: 彰显力量与勇气。跃至空中并连续投掷崇敬标枪。标枪无论是否落地都可以对附近的敌人造成伤害。直接命中敌人将造成更高伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.

scalars.label: Slash Damage On Direct Hit Per Javelin
scalars.labelEn: Slash Damage On Direct Hit Per Javelin

warframes.passiveEn: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.

warframes.description: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。
warframes.descriptionEn: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.

warframes.descriptionEn: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.

abilities.description:
用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害火柱冲击目标敌人。 

反拍节奏：生成更多火柱。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.

scalars.label: Damage Impact Puncture Slash Damage
scalars.labelZh: 伤害冲击穿刺切割伤害

abilities.description:
通过将扬声器推向极度失真来产生一波具有破坏力且带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的热浪，同时使敌人更容易受到暴击。

反拍节奏：暴击几率翻倍。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper’s Wail when it deals damage.

abilities.description:
弹奏吉他，使 Temple 获得短暂无敌并同时获得治疗。每当随着反拍的节奏使用技能时并成功命中敌人时，<AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军武器都会被点亮并获得额外的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

反拍节奏：无敌状态持续时间更长。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

abilities.description:
一旦反拍节拍器上积聚了能量，丽兹就会燃烧起来，用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰焚烧敌人。瞄准时，丽兹以轰鸣的元素声波轰击敌人，可通过技能按键发射不同元素类型的声波。

反拍节奏：本技能不消耗能量。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.

warframes.passive: 与反拍节拍器同步施放技能，以增强技能效果的同时提升 |COST|% 的技能效率。
warframes.passiveEn: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.

warframes.description: Titania 仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。
warframes.descriptionEn: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.

abilities.description: 把敌人扫到空中，使其丢掉武器；让附近的友军对异常状态免疫。长按此技能来使 Titania 获得免疫效果。
abilities.descriptionEn: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.

abilities.description: 当对一名敌人施放技能时，循环切换并从四种增益效果中选取出一种。「荆棘」减免来袭的伤害。「尘埃」降低敌人的精准度。「满月」增加同伴的伤害。「纠缠」使范围内的敌人减速。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.

abilities.descriptionEn: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.

abilities.description: 缩小身体并进入飞行状态，同时剃刀蝶会攻击附近的敌人并放大他们所受到的伤害。

warframes.descriptionEn: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.

abilities.description:

在空中按下闪避即可化身为毁灭性的火焰流星飞行。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.

abilities.descriptionEn: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.

warframes.passive:
Uriel 统领、强化并守护着三位独特的恶魔。

缚魔：束缚并减缓敌人，将他们串联起来。对链条中任意敌人造成的伤害会转移到所有被束缚的敌人身上。（通过炼狱火解锁）

苦魔：吸附在敌人身上，造成持续伤害。如果被击杀，会生成一个痛苦之环。（通过恶魔再生解锁）

烙魔：在倒下的敌人身上刻下恶魔符文，拾取这些符文可以增加射速和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。（通过魔群解锁）
warframes.passiveEn:
Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)

GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)

VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)

warframes.description: Valkyr 被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。
warframes.descriptionEn: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.

abilities.description: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。
abilities.descriptionEn: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.

abilities.description: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。
abilities.descriptionEn: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.

abilities.description: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.

abilities.description: Valkyr 露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。Valkyr 在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。
abilities.descriptionEn: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.

warframes.description: Vauban 是创新技术的典范。他会通过巧妙的部署来对敌人造成群体控制。他的坚韧和专注使他令敌人生畏。
warframes.descriptionEn: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.

abilities.description: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.

用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.

warframes.descriptionEn: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.

abilities.description: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.

abilities.description:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.

scalars.label: Flechette Damage Multiplier Per 10 Enemy Levels
scalars.labelEn: Flechette Damage Multiplier Per 10 Enemy Levels

scalars.label: Blast Damage On Orb Hit
scalars.labelZh: 爆炸伤害时球体命中（第2项）

scalars.labelZh: 布雷器 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 投下一个定位信标，来召唤一场毁灭性的激光火炮打击。对拥有超宏防护的敌人造成双倍伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.

abilities.description:
建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给 Vauban 和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。

长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.

scalars.label: Bastille Armor Buff Rate armor per second
scalars.labelEn: Bastille Armor Buff Rate armor per second
scalars.labelZh: 护甲增益速率护甲每秒

scalars.labelEn: Magnetic Damage Per Second In Vortex

scalars.labelZh: 护甲增益速率来自敌人

warframes.passive: 对失去行动能力的敌人造成 x|DAMAGE| 伤害。
warframes.passiveEn: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.

warframes.description: 电流在 Volt 身上涌动。他的攻击可造成高额伤害，并震慑敌人。
warframes.descriptionEn: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.

abilities.description: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.

abilities.description: 显现一支电流。Volt 与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。
abilities.descriptionEn: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.

abilities.description:
Volt 部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
 
长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 电力屏障 · 持续时间

abilities.description: Volt 会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。
abilities.descriptionEn: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.

warframes.passive: 在地面上移动时可以积蓄电能，每移动一米可积攒 |DAMAGE| 电击伤害，积攒的伤害会在下一次攻击时释放。
warframes.passiveEn: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.

warframes.description: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，Volt Prime 拥有与 Volt 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
warframes.descriptionEn: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.

abilities.description: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.

warframes.description: 四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。
warframes.descriptionEn: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.

abilities.description:
（轻按）戴拿会使 Voruna 隐身并提高她的移动速度。Voruna 攻击时会结束隐身状态。在隐身状态结束后的短时间内，提升近战攻击的暴击伤害、触发几率、暴击几率并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。如果在增益期间近战击杀敌人，这些限时近战增益在每次施放技能时则会延长一次。 

（长按）戴拿会守护 Voruna，提升她的跑酷速度。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

scalars.label: Damage flat melee critical damage bonus
scalars.labelEn: Damage flat melee critical damage bonus
scalars.labelZh: 伤害近战暴击伤害加成

scalars.label: Duration melee buff duration extension
scalars.labelZh: 持续时间近战增益持续时间

abilities.description:
（轻按）亚克什的尖牙会撕裂你的敌人。5 个随机异常状态会在敌人身上堆叠 10 层。当目标死亡时，其身上的异常状态会传播给附近的其他敌人。

（长按）亚克什会守护 Voruna，提升她的异常状态抗性。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

abilities.description:
（轻按）莱卡斯狩猎以维系狼群。被近战击杀的敌人会掉落生命球，被爆头击杀的敌人则会掉落能量球。击杀受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护 Voruna，提升她的重击效率。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath’s hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 莱卡斯之猎 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Health Orb Drop Chance On Melee Kill
scalars.labelEn: Health Orb Drop Chance On Melee Kill
scalars.labelZh: 生命值球体掉落几率时近战击杀

scalars.label: Energy Orb Drop Chance On Headshot Kill
scalars.labelEn: Energy Orb Drop Chance On Headshot Kill
scalars.labelZh: 能量球体掉落几率时爆头击杀

scalars.label: Number Of Statuses For Extra Time: ≥
scalars.labelEn: Number Of Statuses For Extra Time: ≥

abilities.description:
（轻按）Voruna 四肢着地并有 5 次凶残地冲向锁定敌人的机会。在 Voruna 冲向目标时，最强之狼乌尔佛伦会率先发起攻击。狼群们对受到异常状态影响的目标及其周围的敌人造成更高的伤害。致命攻击将使 Voruna 剩余冲锋所造成的伤害翻倍。

（长按）乌尔佛伦守护 Voruna。如果 Voruna 在守护期间死亡，则乌尔佛伦会代替她死去。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.

scalars.label: Range
scalars.labelZh: 乌尔佛伦之裔 · 范围

scalars.label: Radius
scalars.labelZh: 乌尔佛伦之裔 · 半径

scalars.labelZh: 切割每秒伤害持续时间

scalars.labelZh: 加成伤害来自异常效果

warframes.passive: Voruna 从不孤军奋战。在任务中，长按技能可以召唤每匹狼独一无二的被动能力。
warframes.passiveEn: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.

warframes.description: 辉煌与凶猛在 Voruna Prime 身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。
warframes.descriptionEn: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.

warframes.description: Wisp 游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。
warframes.descriptionEn: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.

abilities.description: 选择并召唤一个充满尘埃的储能池来帮助 Wisp 和她的友军。急速尘埃可以增加移动和攻击速度。活力尘埃可以增加最大生命值和治疗时间。震荡尘埃可以震晕附近的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.

scalars.label: Sol Gate Damage Buff
scalars.labelZh: 太阳之门闸门伤害增益

scalars.label: Sol Gate Damage Buff
scalars.labelZh: 太阳之门闸门伤害增益（第2项）

abilities.description: 投射一个 Wisp 的光谱图像来迷惑和分散敌人的注意力。重新启动图像来移动到它所在的位置。按住按键来使图像移动速度更快，并在释放按键时传送到它所在的位置。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 幻影鬼火 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
打开一个维度缺口来压倒附近的敌人，并使他们在受到伤害时释放出侵略性的电涌火花。
Wisp 亦可瞄准一个储能池传送，并倍化涌流的范围。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.

scalars.label: Sol Gate Spark Chance On Hit
scalars.labelEn: Sol Gate Spark Chance On Hit
scalars.labelZh: 太阳之门闸门几率时命中

abilities.description: 打开一扇通往太阳的传送门，放出毁灭性的纯阳等离子光束。按住射击键会使伤害加倍，但同时也会增加能量消耗。当太阳之门持续攻击敌人时，会对敌人造成更多伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.

scalars.label: Boosted Beam Move Speed Penalty
scalars.labelZh: 强化光束移动速度惩罚

scalars.label: Haste Mote Corrosive Status Chance
scalars.labelZh: 晶体腐蚀异常触发几率

scalars.label: Breach Surge Spark Chance On Hit
scalars.labelEn: Breach Surge Spark Chance On Hit

warframes.passive: 在维度之间流动，Wisp 在空中时对敌人来说是隐形的。
warframes.passiveEn: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

warframes.description: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。
warframes.descriptionEn: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.

abilities.descriptionEn: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.

scalars.label: Boosted Beam Move Speed Penalty
scalars.labelZh: 强化光束移动速度惩罚

scalars.label: Haste Mote Corrosive Status Chance
scalars.labelZh: 晶体腐蚀异常触发几率

scalars.label: Breach Surge Spark Chance On Hit
scalars.labelEn: Breach Surge Spark Chance On Hit

warframes.passive: 在维度之间流动，Wisp 在空中时对敌人来说是隐形的。
warframes.passiveEn: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

warframes.description: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。
warframes.descriptionEn: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.

abilities.description:
Wukong 拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.

scalars.label: twin lifespan
scalars.labelZh: 天圣双身 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗 Wukong 和他的分身。
abilities.descriptionEn: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

scalars.label: Cloud Duration
scalars.labelZh: 筋斗游云 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.

scalars.label: Invulnerability Duration
scalars.labelZh: 死命顽抗 · 技能持续时间

abilities.description: 召唤出定海神针并释放猴王的怒火。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.

warframes.passive: 在承受致命伤害后，Wukong 会自动使用他所掌握的其中一种保命神技。每次任务中，这些神技只能发动三次。
warframes.passiveEn: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

warframes.description: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。
warframes.descriptionEn: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.

warframes.description: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。
warframes.descriptionEn: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.

abilities.description: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 真理密语 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 虚空卷须偷取附近敌人的武器，以作为自己的浮空自瞄武器来使用。伤害输出会根据敌人等级增加。抢到的武器数量也决定了「失落之技：否认」的虚空射线的伤害倍数。
abilities.descriptionEn: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 虚空之握 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 循环切换三种失落之技。「指责」幻化出虚空裂缝，来让敌人堕落成为友军。「凝视」通过虚空卷须抓住目标，并在目标被释放时，捕捉伤害并对目标造成伤害。「否认」通过一束虚空能量来进行湮灭攻击，并消除 Sentient 抗性。
abilities.descriptionEn: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 失落之技 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 失落之技 · 持续时间（第2项）

scalars.label: Range
scalars.labelZh: 失落之技 · 范围（第2项）

abilities.description: Xaku 的外层结构在毁灭性的爆炸中暂时舍弃，然后以全新的的骨骼形态疾步潜行于战场。受到 Xaku 身体碎片击中的敌人会更难抵御 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。在超维炼狱施放期间，Xaku 其他主动技能的持续时间将会冻结，技能终止时恢复。
abilities.descriptionEn: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 超维炼狱 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Dodge Chance And Area Damage Reduction
scalars.labelEn: Dodge Chance And Area Damage Reduction
scalars.labelZh: 闪避几率与区域伤害减免

warframes.passiveEn: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.

warframes.description: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。
warframes.descriptionEn: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.

warframes.description: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。
warframes.descriptionEn: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.

abilities.description:
生成五个主动寻找敌人并会在触碰时膨胀的水球，同时对受害者造成伤害并使他们无法移动。
被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.

scalars.label: Ensnare Duration
scalars.labelZh: 深海诱陷 · 持续时间

scalars.label: Globule Lifetime
scalars.labelZh: 深海诱陷 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description: 召唤浪漪珊瑚，这是一种浪涌中的可骑乘生物，也是 K 式悬浮板的灵感来源。浪漪珊瑚通过吸收大部分来袭的伤害从而保护 Yareli。
abilities.descriptionEn: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.

abilities.description: 通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 水形之刃 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 把敌人拖入一个毁灭性的漩涡中，然后用一股爆裂水压将他们炸飞。每个被困在漩涡中的敌人都会增加爆裂造成的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 激流漩涌 · 持续时间

warframes.passive: 当 Yareli 移动超过 |TIME| 秒时，她的次要武器获得 +|CHANCE|% 的暴击几率。
warframes.passiveEn: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.

warframes.description: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。
warframes.descriptionEn: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.

warframes.description: 掌控风之力量。Zephyr 的旋风技能可以保护她、造成高伤害并提供群体控制。她从上方俯冲而下，留下一条毁灭之路。
warframes.descriptionEn: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.

abilities.description: 在空中按住技能键，来使 Zephyr 悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。
abilities.descriptionEn: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.

abilities.description: 发射一团高密度爆发空气。长按把敌人击飞，轻按则把他们拉向爆炸中央。每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害就会增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.

abilities.description: 围绕Zephyr生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。
abilities.descriptionEn: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 疾风湍流 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 龙卷云风 · 持续时间

warframes.passiveEn: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.

warframes.description: 用这只富有破坏力的金色小鸟飞向天空。
warframes.descriptionEn: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.

abilities.description:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗 Lavos。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

abilities.description:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.

scalars.label: Cold Status Effect Stacks Per Proc
scalars.labelEn: Cold Status Effect Stacks Per Proc
scalars.labelZh: 冰冻异常效果层数每触发

abilities.description:
布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

abilities.descriptionEn: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.

abilities.descriptionEn: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 晶化生长 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.

abilities.description: Gara 的护甲会分裂为碎玻璃组成的漩涡。置身其中的友军可减免敌人的伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 玻片风暴 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 光谱盛怒 · 持续时间

abilities.descriptionEn: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. abilities.description: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.

abilities.description: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。
abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 精神混乱 · 持续时间

abilities.descriptionEn: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. abilities.description:
Koumei 预视到了一个美好的未来以及实现它的具体步骤。完成挑战即可获得王令。运气不好的掷骰结果会带来一种减益，但你可以长按技能键以放弃该御神签。

掷出三个六则可以直接获得王令，无需挑战。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.

scalars.labelEn: ≤ unlucky dice roll with random penalty

abilities.description:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间获得无敌效果。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

abilities.description:
像操纵牵线木偶一样操纵敌人的命运之线。Koumei 的骰子决定了 Koumei 面前的敌人将承受的异常状态数量。

掷出三个六会造成持续的额外异常状态，并将人偶戏效果延伸到 Koumei 背后的敌人。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

abilities.description:
Wukong 拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.

scalars.label: twin lifespan
scalars.labelZh: 天圣双身 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗 Wukong 和他的分身。
abilities.descriptionEn: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

scalars.label: Cloud Duration
scalars.labelZh: 筋斗游云 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.

scalars.label: Invulnerability Duration

abilities.description: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

abilities.description:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 手雷散射 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 炽烈炮击 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。
abilities.descriptionEn: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 后勤支援 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，Protea 可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从 Protea 放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时死亡的话，启用回溯会使 Protea 回到过去，从而使其免于死亡。Protea 仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.

abilities.description:
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。击杀和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 悲剧：连续施放两个「暗之诗句」能够攻击敌人。来自 切割、火焰和 毒素异常状态造成的持续伤害将累积成一次性的爆发。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 守词者：「明之诗句」后跟着「暗之诗句」，将以夜枭分身为友军提供支援。夜枭分身会与其指定友军同步进行攻击。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally’s attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

abilities.description: 激活时，攻击将造成额外的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害；该效果对近战攻击有双倍加成。攻击被孢子感染的敌人将立刻引爆孢子。
abilities.descriptionEn: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 剧毒鞭笞 · 持续时间

abilities.description: Saryn 以剧毒之雾污染空气，腐蚀范围内的敌人。依据敌人所受到的毒素与病毒影响受到额外伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.

abilities.description: 使目标受到<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀孢子的感染。破坏孢子或杀死宿主可以将孢子扩散到附近的敌人。孢子扩散的时间越久，伤害就越高。
abilities.descriptionEn: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.

abilities.description:
投掷 Sirius 的翠玉之光镰刀，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并拾取路径上的所有物品。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用重力斩。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.

abilities.description:
Sirius 召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用星壳。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 翠玉之星 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius 会创造一个光之井，治疗并复活友军，同时减少受到的伤害。光之井的体积和威力会缓慢增长。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用事件视界。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 光之圣域 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.

abilities.description:
用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害火柱冲击目标敌人。 

反拍节奏：生成更多火柱。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.

scalars.label: Damage Impact Puncture Slash Damage
scalars.labelZh: 伤害冲击穿刺切割伤害

abilities.description:
通过将扬声器推向极度失真来产生一波具有破坏力且带有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的热浪，同时使敌人更容易受到暴击。

反拍节奏：暴击几率翻倍。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper’s Wail when it deals damage.

abilities.description:
弹奏吉他，使 Temple 获得短暂无敌并同时获得治疗。每当随着反拍的节奏使用技能时并成功命中敌人时，<AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军武器都会被点亮并获得额外的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

反拍节奏：无敌状态持续时间更长。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally’s weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.

scalars.label: Duration buff duration
scalars.labelZh: 持续时间增益持续时间

abilities.description:
一旦反拍节拍器上积聚了能量，丽兹就会燃烧起来，用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰焚烧敌人。瞄准时，丽兹以轰鸣的元素声波轰击敌人，可通过技能按键发射不同元素类型的声波。

反拍节奏：本技能不消耗能量。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.

abilities.description: 在空中按住技能键，来使 Zephyr 悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。
abilities.descriptionEn: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.

abilities.description: 发射一团高密度爆发空气。长按把敌人击飞，轻按则把他们拉向爆炸中央。每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害就会增加。
abilities.descriptionEn: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.

abilities.description: 围绕Zephyr生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。
abilities.descriptionEn: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 疾风湍流 · 持续时间

abilities.description: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。
abilities.descriptionEn: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 龙卷云风 · 持续时间

abilities.descriptionEn: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.

abilities.description:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.

abilities.descriptionEn: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.

abilities.description:
建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给 Vauban 和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。

长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.

abilities.description:
（轻按）戴拿会使 Voruna 隐身并提高她的移动速度。Voruna 攻击时会结束隐身状态。在隐身状态结束后的短时间内，提升近战攻击的暴击伤害、触发几率、暴击几率并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。如果在增益期间近战击杀敌人，这些限时近战增益在每次施放技能时则会延长一次。 

（长按）戴拿会守护 Voruna，提升她的跑酷速度。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

abilities.description:
（轻按）亚克什的尖牙会撕裂你的敌人。5 个随机异常状态会在敌人身上堆叠 10 层。当目标死亡时，其身上的异常状态会传播给附近的其他敌人。

（长按）亚克什会守护 Voruna，提升她的异常状态抗性。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

abilities.description:
（轻按）莱卡斯狩猎以维系狼群。被近战击杀的敌人会掉落生命球，被爆头击杀的敌人则会掉落能量球。击杀受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护 Voruna，提升她的重击效率。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath’s hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

abilities.description:
（轻按）Voruna 四肢着地并有 5 次凶残地冲向锁定敌人的机会。在 Voruna 冲向目标时，最强之狼乌尔佛伦会率先发起攻击。狼群们对受到异常状态影响的目标及其周围的敌人造成更高的伤害。致命攻击将使 Voruna 剩余冲锋所造成的伤害翻倍。

（长按）乌尔佛伦守护 Voruna。如果 Voruna 在守护期间死亡，则乌尔佛伦会代替她死去。
abilities.descriptionEn:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.

abilities.descriptionEn: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.

被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。

Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.

abilities.descriptionEn: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

scalars.labelZh: 轻抚－激怒 · 范围（第2项）

abilities.description: 〈黑夜型态〉在附近被击杀的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为 Equinox 及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.

abilities.description:
使用 Orion 的邪恶镰刀击退敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害和异常状态，同时削弱敌人的护盾和护甲。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用日冕抛射。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.

abilities.description:
将 Orion 包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用翠玉之星。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.

scalars.label: clone duration
scalars.labelZh: 星壳 · 持续时间（第2项）

abilities.description:
Orion 形成一个漂移的黑洞，将敌人困于其引力之中。以「重力斩」或「日冕抛射」命中黑洞可延长其持续时间，并改变其移动轨迹：「重力斩」会使其远离 Orion，而「日冕抛射」会将其拉向 Sirius。

（按住）切换至 Sirius 并使用「光之圣域」。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.

scalars.label: Duration
scalars.labelZh: 事件视界 · 持续时间

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。
abilities.descriptionEn:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
